title: Structured native interactions
donor_paths: Frozen inventory remains in task00 tasks.json id 07 (closed PR647, evidence 7ac9b4ac). This feature integrates the transferred SDK, connection projection, serialized resolution, OMP bootstrap, Hub redaction and mobile form files plus their shared module/caller migrations; the central inventory is not duplicated here.
implementation: Existing typed permission forms support secret, editor prefill, empty/verbatim input and deny-dismiss. Provisional OMP startup publishes dialogs before initialization; one writer releases queued input once, failures settle normally and logical receipts remain distinct from native persistence. Explicit SDK/app capability negotiation drives connection-owned event/timeline/get/list/subscription/finish.wait projections. Private non-Serde PermissionContext reaches serialized resolution, rejects incapable secret ALLOW from live pending state, keeps DENY valid and sanitizes RPC success echoes. Durable Hub permission publications are invalidation markers. Secret inputs stay masked and lock during response; option selection resets both visible custom text and its answer. No Bot feature or new authorization system.
acceptance: Explicit SDK hello opt-in reaches Context.secret_questions; legacy secret events and GET/list/subscription snapshots are valid DENY-only upgrade cards without answer-bearing fields; capable and nonsecret views are unchanged; live serialized resolution rejects incapable ALLOW and JSON spoofing while retaining DENY; RPC and durable Hub redaction preserve exact native answers; startup failure/draft receipt/concurrent approval regressions and actual browser flows pass; secure/multiline/empty/cancel UI regressions pass.
compatibility: agent-secret-questions-v1 is an optional, explicit app capability; only literal true opts in. Old hosts may omit it without blocking connection. New hosts project incapable secret views to cancel-only tool permissions and reject secret ALLOW server-side. Negotiation is compatibility, not authorization or proof of honest client implementation. No new RPC envelope or ACP structure. EventHub::subscribe gains a mandatory capability argument; all callers migrate, internal observers default incapable. ADR-243 remains proposed. Task01 and task31 are skipped by user decision; verified task01 prerequisite code remains a dependency, not a downstream macOS-CI blocker.
